verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS observability and evaluation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to export traces, datasets, metrics, or annotations in open formats. OpenTelemetry support is ingestion-side, and MCP dataset management is a related feature, not export, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
